ModMetaData.name: HSK Algae Cultivation
ModMetaData.author: smokerdl
ModMetaData.description: Supported version: RimWorld 1.6. Adds a selectable aquatic crop zone for HSK PlantAlgae and Odyssey Plant_Reeds. HSK's Odyssey patch makes reeds yield Hay at 3 per harvest. SeedsPlease is optional. The included 1.5 folder and prebuilt DLL are retained as a frozen legacy snapshot and are no longer supported or updated.
